plugins.name: claudetto
plugins.description: Tunes Claude Code for coding at the lowest token cost, through its official extension points only: settings, hooks, skills, and an output style. It patches nothing. The tree is a rebuild in progress, and each capability lands with the measurement that decided its values. The one decided default is the compaction path, which stays the built-in compaction of Claude Code until a measured probe result beats it.

plugins.name: claudetto-you-should-know
plugins.description: Shows one short note above the prompt when a side check finds something about the work that the person very likely does not understand. It ships off. Once on, it makes one small bounded request every sixth step, sends nothing else out, and keeps no telemetry.
